axes.model_access: The platform ships no in-house model — the README's official wording is "powered by OpenAI", models are integrated through the platform; the current Cloud line's model list not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Cloud-hosted form (app.botpress.cloud / studio.botpress.cloud direct 200 same day); the GitHub main repo's on-record "This Repository" = integrations/devtools/bots/plugins (the integrations & devtools surface, not the product itself); self-hosting goes through the old v12 repo (botpress/v12, AGPL-3.0).
axes.local_files: On the Cloud line data lives in Botpress's cloud (Knowledge Bases/Tables components on record same day); the v12 on-prem form keeps data on your machine — the two generations have different data surfaces.
axes.background: Always-on agents are the official lead form (same-day homepage wording: taking real actions on refunds/account updates/multi-step workflows); queueing and resume details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The Hub integration ecosystem is on record same day (Intercom/Zendesk/Hubspot/Salesforce); channels on record (Webchat/WhatsApp/Slack etc.); dev surface on record (@botpress/sdk, @botpress/cli, bots-as-code examples). No MCP support verified in official statements.
axes.context: Knowledge Bases/Tables are the persistent knowledge surface (on record same day); cross-session memory mechanism details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Enterprise-facing (same-day homepage on record: SOC 2 compliant); the ToS routes customers to two contracting entities by location (on record same day); the terms state a business purpose ("not for personal or household purposes"); training-use toggle path not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: support-scenario agents (ticket deflection, escalation & handoff, AI actions), a ready integration ecosystem (CRM/helpdesk). Not a fit: wanting the product itself open source, a filed direct-mainland entry, personal use (the ToS says business-only).
